scripts.//screens: Regenerates the WebP variants after adding or replacing a PNG in public/assets/screens/. Deliberately NOT part of `build`: the variants are committed, and the GitHub Actions runner has no cwebp.
scripts.//appstore-screenshots: Renders the App Store Connect submission screenshots (iPhone 6.9" master, 1320x2868) from real app captures. Writes outside the repo to the private asset folder named in content.mjs, not site/public/, these aren't web assets.
